task.title: Record a fixture set that covers the main kinds of league
task.description:
## Why
The port is only as trustworthy as the cases it is checked against. Today's tests cover a handful of trade rules and nothing in grading, metrics, trade history or the brief.

## Steps
1. Pick leagues and teams to cover at least:
   - the two shipped formats: 12-team Superflex half-PPR, with and without TE premium
   - a 1QB league and a redraft league
   - one team for each call: contend, retool and rebuild
   - a league in season and one in the off-season before its draft
   - a league with several past seasons and one with none
   - a league whose run produces three-team deals
2. Record, scrub and commit each under `web/test/fixtures/<name>/` with its inputs, intermediate results and final outputs.
3. List the fixtures and what each one covers in `web/test/fixtures/README.md`.

## Done when
- At least eight fixtures are committed and every case in the list above is covered by one of them.
- Pull request checks, including the public-data guard, pass.
